messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help immediately if you have drooling.
Get emergency medical help immediately if you have wheezing.
Cetirizine is not a substitute for an epinephrine injector.
Do not use cetirizine to prevent hives from known causes such as foods, insect stings, or medicines.
Call your doctor if your hives do not improve after 3 days.
Call your doctor if hives last more than 6 weeks.
Call your doctor if hives are an unusual color.
Call your doctor if hives look bruised.
Call your doctor if hives are blistered.
Call your doctor if hives do not itch.
Rarely, some people have reported severe itching when stopping cetirizine.
This occurred after daily, long-term use of at least a few months or several years.
If you experience widespread, severe itching on stopping this medication, contact your healthcare provider.
Triplet: ["Cetirizine", "not a substitute for", "epinephrine injector"]

The relation 'not a substitute for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be used in place of the medical device or medication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'should not be used in place of': The subject entity should not be substituted for the object entity in treatment.
C. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
D. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
E. 'not caused by': The subject medical condition is not associated with the cause specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
